description: An Accept without a profile the server offers (an unknown profile or version, a weight of 0, another media type) is 406 with RPP-Code 02004 (core 14.3).
comment: Skipped on epp-docker: the EPP config signals the profile by the RPP-Profile header; profile_signalling_header/ covers the header method.

steps.comment: Reads the discovery document, with Content-Type application/rpp+json; profile="urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:base"; profile-version="1.0", Accept application/rpp+json; profile="urn:example:nope"; profile-version="1.0"; expects 406 02004. An error answer this case checks.
